caseNameFull: Holder, U. S. District Judge v. Banks

opinions.text:
C. A. 7th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 414 U. S. 1156.] Motion of petitioner to dispense with printing appendix. *934and to proceed on original record granted. Motion of American Civil Liberties Union et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. . Motion of petitioner for divided argument denied.

Me. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
